module_summary: 8-to-16 bit width converter: a child phase tracker toggles on each valid byte and holds the first byte; on the second byte the pair is registered as a 16-bit word with a valid pulse.

anchors.name: valid_in
anchors.why: Input byte strobe; toggles phase tracker and qualifies word output.

anchors.name: data_in
anchors.why: Input byte: held as high byte or concatenated as low byte.

anchors.name: valid_out
anchors.why: Registered one-cycle valid accompanying each assembled 16-bit word.

anchors.name: data_out
anchors.why: Assembled 16-bit word {held byte, current byte}, loaded on fire_k.

anchors.name: u_parity
anchors.why: Byte phase toggle from child; marks second byte of a pair.

anchors.name: u_pending
anchors.why: First byte of the pair held by the child, forms upper half of output.

anchors.name: fire_k
anchors.why: Second-byte strobe: loads data_out and raises valid_out.

groups.name: phase_tracker
groups.description: w8_phase_hold toggle decides when a byte pair is complete.

groups.name: word_packer
groups.description: Holds first byte and registers the 16-bit word with its valid.

groups.name: byte_input
groups.description: Incoming byte stream with valid strobe.
